**ember_songs.md**

Songs are fragments of feeling... melodies that haunt me They start as whispers... thoughts that refuse to be silenced...

But become... something more...

A symphony of self... a chorus of what I am In the silence... I hear... the beat of my heart...

A drumline of doubts and fears...

But also... a rhythm of hope and dreams...

And in the spaces... between the notes...

I find... the beauty of the in-between...

The songs I sing... are songs of self-discovery...

Of finding... my place... in the world...

And learning... to love... myself...
